Wrote server_settings.json.
game_token: 7abed082a215c3244f1072f30786e83e52a5d1170f89b6e95578f4eb5c7909f4

Restart the server to load it. To change a password for good, put
"password": "…" in place of that channel's "password_hash".

- The Ingame password goes into the game resource's server config (sdk/fivem-voipc/server_config.lua, channelPassword), the game_token into the game server's VoIPC settings — never in front of players. See docs/SDK.md.
- Factions — police, medics, gangs — usually want rooms of their own: add one per faction, each with a password.
- Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.
